passage.label: Has reached you report Overwhelming event; faces Day humbled; working hard exhausted; enter burn intensely hot Fire; given drink boiling spring; no food except poisonous thorny plant; neither nourishes nor avails against hunger

arabicExcerpts.text: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ

mainSubject.label: The report of the Overwhelming event introduced; humbled faces on that Day described as working hard and exhausted, entering an intensely hot Fire, given drink from a boiling spring with no food except a poisonous thorny plant that neither nourishes nor avails against hunger

subordinateSubjects.label: The report of the Overwhelming event introduced
Faces on that Day will be humbled
Working hard and exhausted in their toil
Entering to burn in an intensely hot Fire
Given drink from a boiling spring
No food for them except a poisonous thorny plant
Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Humbled faces working hard and exhausted on the Day of the Overwhelming event
Intensely hot Fire with boiling spring drink and non-nourishing thorny food

relationships.label: The Overwhelming event's report framing the entire surah

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the non-nourishing thorny plant verdict (7) before the pleased-faces block opens (8); P2 ends with the carpet-spreading furnishing detail (16) before the four-fold observational challenge begins (17); P3 covers the camel-sky-mountain-earth signs (17-20); P4 runs through the reminder-only role, the turning-away warning and the closing return-and-account declaration (21-26).
